system.description:
Requirements: Soul (5), 6 Arbiter abilities, and you must receive training from another Lord Inquisitor or have access to their teachings

Cost: 2 Resolve

Range: 30 spaces

You are the bane of the supernatural, and the judge of the guilty.

As an Action, you may pronounce a curse of judgment upon another creature you can see within 30 spaces.

  • All Damage it takes is increased by +2.

  • Its Defense decreases by -1.

  • All attacks against it are considered Magical for the purpose of bypassing resistances.

  • Once per turn, when the creature would recover Stamina, you may prevent it from doing so as a Free Action.

This effect lasts until the end of combat, you become Incapacitated, or you are Dying. After you use this ability, you cannot use any ability with the Apex trait until you complete a Long Rest.

Additionally, law-enforcement officials, exorcists, and other followers of the Path of the Arbiter will recognize your skill and afford you special respect.
